_comment: Greptile review configuration. The value here is whole-repo context, so
the instructions point it at the failure mode this codebase actually
produces: one fact maintained in two places, drifting apart silently.
Every incident of 2026-08 was that shape -- a client-slug map duplicating
the registry, a wrapper holding its own copy of a delete, a scorer living
in two files, a published package contradicting a published standard.
instructions: Flag any fact maintained in two places that could drift: hardcoded maps duplicating a database table, scoring or validation logic copied between files, a constant restated rather than imported. Name both locations.
Flag claims in user-facing strings that assert causation the code cannot support, and any pricing, engine count, or product name in a string literal, since these go stale silently.

Flag code that reports success without verifying the outcome: a send path that returns ok when suppressed, a check that passes when the thing it checks is absent, a catch that swallows an error without recording it.
Flag a conditional that can never be true, especially a guard whose predicate is defeated by an upstream default.
Do not flag SQL template literals where the interpolated value is a module-level constant and all user values use placeholders. That pattern is intentional in worker/src/db.ts.
